description: Get the recorded FLOOR ROLL-CALL VOTES on a Washington State legislative bill — chamber, motion ("3rd Reading & Final Passage"), date, and yea/nay/absent/excused counts with the voting legislators named in each category. Most recent vote first. Reads directly from the Washington State Legislature's own bill-tracking service. Use for "how did the House vote on HB 1002", "did SB 5016 pass the Senate". Voice votes and committee-only votes are not recorded here. Keyless.

biennium.description: Washington biennium, e.g. "2025-26" or a year like "2026". Omit for the current biennium.

bill.description: Bill number, with or without prefix: "HB 1002", "SB 5016", or bare "1002".

name: wa_bill_votes
title: Wa Bill Votes
